recipe.title: Caramel Pecan Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipe.summary: Creamy cottage cheese topped with candied pecans and sugar-free caramel, served with a Built Puff pumpkin cookie protein bar.
recipe.story: Savory cottage cheese and sweet caramel play off each other here, with a Built Puff bar on the side adding crunch and pumpkin-cookie flavor for the season.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon Splenda brown sugar blend (optional, for candying the pecans)
1 Built Puff Pumpkin Cookie Chunk bar, served on the side
instructions: Optional upgrade: toss the chopped pecans with the Splenda brown sugar blend in a small microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 30 to 45 seconds, stirring halfway, until fragrant. Let cool for 1 minute so they crisp up.
Scoop the cottage cheese into a bowl and sprinkle with the cinnamon.
Top with the pecans (candied or plain) and drizzle with the sugar-free caramel sauce.
Serve with the Built Puff bar on the side, or break it up and stir it in if you'd like extra crunch.
tips: Short on time? Skip the candying step — plain chopped pecans still taste great here.
Keep the Built Puff bar whole and serve it alongside for the cleanest presentation, or break it up right before eating for extra crunch in the bowl.
Warm the caramel sauce for about 10 seconds if you want it extra drizzly.

images.image_prompt: Two items styled together in one photo. Item one: a bowl of creamy plain cottage cheese topped with a small pile of dark caramel-glazed candied pecan pieces and a light drizzle of caramel sauce. The cottage cheese and pecans are the only things in the bowl -- no bar pieces, no cubes, no crumbs, no crumble of any kind on top of or inside the bowl. Item two, placed on the wood surface right next to the bowl: one full Built Puff Pumpkin Cookie Chunk protein bar, whole and fully sealed inside its original printed retail wrapper. Do not open, unwrap, cut, or crumble this bar -- show it exactly as a sealed packaged snack bar, wrapper fully intact, brand packaging and readable label visible. The two items sit side by side as one styled scene. Warm amber fall light, rust linen napkin, natural wood surface, no fruit or extra garnish.
